name: Inhaling Seagull
meaning: A seagull calmly perches, then inhales deeper and deeper before screaming, drawn in red. For building frustration that explodes into a scream.
when_to_use: text1 = the calm starting statement (top panel). text2 = continuing (second panel). text3 = a short word as the inhale peaks (third panel, small). text4 = the screamed punchline (bottom red panel), often all caps.
